It integrated recent returns without duplicate successors, completed the reusable Primary Chat state/time communication contract, verified the allocator fixed-generation gate against the live frontier, preserved external/safety/source boundaries, reverted one blocked paired write safely, and closed with no hidden partial rollout or authority bypass.
